evidence_quotes.quote: Non-conventional public-private partnerships for water supply to urban slums
The authors investigated NGO led water supply arrangements in six slums of Dhaka city to show that the interventions are a variant form of PPP

rationale: WRONG_PAPER_MISMATCH (paper_mention_mismatch; reason: "full text not accessible" for target record). Record R05A5348ECB82 specifies Fabre, Anaïs & Straub, Stéphane (2019), "The Economic Impact of public private partnerships (PPPs) in Infrastructure, Health and Education: A Review". However, the retrieved PDF is an entirely different article: Khandker Zakir Hossain & Shafiul Azam Ahmed (2015), "Non-conventional public-private partnerships for water supply to urban slums", Urban Water Journal, 12(7), 570-580, DOI: 10.1080/1573062X.2014.923473. Per mandatory screening rules, because the retrieved PDF is clearly a different paper from the record metadata and guessing from the title alone is prohibited, both decision and plain_criterion2_decision are set to "cannot_tell" with exclusion_code "NONE".
